patch.value: Windows published-release verifier test can preempt its own readiness and cleanup contract

The test-specific evaluator readiness bound is lower than the outer process timeout by at least the full shutdown grace; timeout arithmetic is asserted explicitly; the expected invalid-discovery path and port-reuse cleanup remain required; focused, full coverage, static, and hosted Windows gates pass.
